nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set to tx.origin in the XYToken constructor; gates privileged functions.
Address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract used for arbitrary low-level calls.
Uniswap V2 pair address derived by pairForUniswap and stored publicly.
Public mapping of token balances; written directly without SafeMath in transferFrom, distribute and list.
Public nested mapping of allowances, modified in approve, transferFrom and the constructor.
Total token supply, used in list to compute the owner share (totalSupply * 6 / 100).
Uniswap V2 router instance used by list to add liquidity.
Wrapped ETH address used in the constructor for pair derivation.
Base constructor that stores the bot protection address.
Modifier performing an external low-level call to botProtection before the guarded function body executes.
Public transfer that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the sender.
Transfers tokens, decrementing allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Sets the allowance of spender from msg.sender.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2-style hashing.
Owner-only function making an external botProtection call and overwriting recipient balances in a loop.
Owner-only function that mints balances, adds liquidity on Uniswap using block.timestamp as deadline and distributes amounts.
Caller-controlled address used for allowance checks and owner requirement checks.
Origin address used directly to set the owner and pre-approve the Uniswap pair.
Used as deadline for the Uniswap addLiquidityETH call in list.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata inside delegate.
Low-level .call to the botProtection address used in the checkBots modifier, distribute and list.
Unchecked subtraction/addition and multiplication on balances, allowances and supply.
External payable call to the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with user supplied parameters and ETH.
Sender parameter of transferFrom, used for allowance and balance checks.
Recipient parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer, transferFrom and approve.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate passed to delegatecall.
First token address parameter of pairForUniswap.
Second token address parameter of pairForUniswap.
Array of recipient addresses used in distribute and list.
Amount assigned to each recipient in distribute.
Token amount used for liquidity listing in list.
Array of amounts distributed to recipients in list.
Boolean result of the delegatecall returned by delegate.
Computed pair address returned by pairForUniswap.
Lower-ordered token address in pairForUniswap.
Higher-ordered token address in pairForUniswap.
Boolean success flag of the botProtection call in the checkBots modifier.
Return bytes of the botProtection call in the checkBots modifier.
Loop index used in distribute and list.
Bot protection address passed to the BotProtected and XYToken constructors.
Derived constructor that sets owner to tx.origin, computes uniPair and grants infinite allowances.

edges.reason: _from is forwarded into the botProtection external call of the modifier.
_to is forwarded into the botProtection external call of the modifier.
_value is forwarded into the botProtection external call of the modifier.
uniPair is read and passed as argument to the botProtection call.
The modifier performs an external call to botProtection before transferFrom updates state.
checkBots guards transferFrom and runs the external call before the guarded body.
The call result notABot is required to be true to continue execution.
Return bytes isNotBot are captured from the botProtection call.
transferFrom uses msg.sender to validate and decrement allowance.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance.
_from drives allowance and balance checks in transferFrom.
_to receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
_value determines how much allowance and balance are decremented.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and other balance/allowance updates are unchecked arithmetic.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument.
_to is forwarded to transferFrom by transfer.
_value is forwarded to transferFrom by transfer.
approve writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_spender receives the allowance in approve.
_value sets the allowance amount in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender to equal the owner address.
The owner state variable is the access control gate for delegate.
delegate forwards the supplied address and calldata into a delegatecall.
User-supplied address a is the delegatecall target.
User-supplied bytes b is the delegatecall payload.
The delegatecall success flag is assigned to the local success variable.
pairForUniswap returns the address stored in uniPair.
tokenA is used to compute the pair address.
tokenB is used to compute the pair address.
token0 is hashed into the pair derivation.
token1 is hashed into the pair derivation.
The computed address is assigned to local pair.
distribute reverts unless msg.sender is the owner.
owner is the privileged caller required by distribute.
distribute performs an external botProtection call with the _tos array.
_tos recipients receive the fixed amount balance in distribute.
amount is written to every recipient balance in distribute.
The loop index i bounds the distribution loop.
distribute directly overwrites the balanceOf mapping without checks.
list reverts unless msg.sender is the owner.
owner is the privileged caller required by list.
list uses block.timestamp as the Uniswap deadline, making it miner-influenceable.
list calls the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with user supplied amounts and ETH.
list performs an external botProtection call with the _tos array.
list invokes the routerForUniswap contract.
list writes balanceOf[address(this)], balanceOf[msg.sender] and recipient balances.
list computes the owner balance as totalSupply * 6 / 100.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 is unchecked multiplication and division.
_numList determines liquidity and contract balance in list.
_amounts provides the values written to recipient balances in list.
_tos provides the recipients distributed to in list.
The loop index i bounds the distribution loop in list.
_botProtection is stored by the BotProtected constructor.
The constructor writes the botProtection state variable.
_botProtection is forwarded to the base constructor by XYToken.
The constructor trusts tx.origin to set the owner and pre-approve the pair.
The owner state variable is assigned from tx.origin in the constructor.
The constructor stores the pair computed for wETH and the token.
The constructor grants unlimited allowances on the allowance mapping.
The constructor calls pairForUniswap to derive uniPair.
wETH is used as an argument for the pair computation.
tx.origin is granted an infinite allowance to uniPair in the constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the sender argument of transferFrom and its bot check.
_to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer/transferFrom.
_value is only meaningful for the allowance and balance updates of transferFrom.
_spender exists solely as the approve spender argument.
a is the untrusted target consumed directly by the delegatecall.
b is the untrusted payload consumed directly by the delegatecall.
tokenA is only used to derive the pair address.
tokenB is only used to derive the pair address.
_tos is the recipient array iterated by distribute and the bot call.
amount is written to each balance inside distribute.
_numList only parameterizes the liquidity listing in list.
_amounts only parameterizes the recipient balances in list.
success is just the boolean outcome of the delegatecall.
pair is just the return value of the pair derivation.
token0 is a temporary ordering variable inside pairForUniswap.
token1 is a temporary ordering variable inside pairForUniswap.
notABot is only the success flag of the bot protection call in the modifier.
isNotBot is only the returndata of the botProtection external call.
i is only the loop counter of the distribution loops.
_botProtection only feeds the constructor that stores botProtection.
